verdict.rationale: The CLI explicitly supports selecting individual skills via `--skill` flags (repeatable) or interactive selection, rather than installing the whole bundle, e.g. `npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill frontend-design --skill skill-creator`, plus a `--list`/list-only mode to preview before choosing. This is well documented in first-party GitHub docs with concrete command examples. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that partial installs work as documented (community evidence only discusses ranking/leaderboard concerns, not install granularity), and no mention of dependency handling when a skill references others.
